capabilities: show vault statistics and note-health metrics (isolated, empty, or very short notes)
manage an editable todo list sourced from one configured Markdown file
render an interactive 3D knowledge graph with orbit controls and clickable notes
display 365-day writing heatmaps, cumulative link charts, and word-count trends
launch installed plugins from a reorderable shortcut strip
extras: The interface is written in Chinese. All statistics stay in the local plugin data file with no network calls. Includes detailed metric definitions and pre-install activity estimation behavior.
problem: Obsidian has no single home view that combines vault health metrics, task tracking, activity statistics, and graph browsing in one place.

relations.evidence: The color system and restrained dark surfaces are inspired by insanum/obsidian_nord.

summary: Home dashboard that shows vault statistics, note health issues, an editable todo list, a 3D knowledge graph, plugin shortcuts, and writing activity charts.
